ساجد سموسہ کی عید شاپنگ | قسط 1
summary: Sajid Samosa challenges his wife that he can complete their Eid shopping under a tight budget of 2000 rupees. He heads to the chaotic market, tries to bargain aggressively, but ends up buying a shop curtain by mistake during a sudden power outage. While trying to return it, he causes a scene and hides inside a high-end ladies boutique, where he is mistaken for a salesman and ultimately gets caught by his own wife.

series_title: گلو میاں اور اسمارٹ فون کا عذاب
summary: Gullu Mian is severely addicted to his smartphone, causing continuous chaos at home. His mother gets fed up and confiscates his phone, hiding it somewhere in the kitchen. Gullu attempts a midnight ninja mission to steal his phone back, but his plan turns into a hilarious disaster when he gets caught with frozen meat instead, only to discover a funny secret about his mother.

summary: Sajid Samosa gets caught by his wife inside a ladies boutique after hiding from a curtain mishap. His angry wife forces him to wear the colorful curtain as a cape and gives him a second chance with a strict warning. She hands him a massive list of grocery and clothes to buy within the remaining budget. Sajid bravely marches towards the crowded shoe market while sweating profusely.
